rules.name: cs-33-swap-mtm-leg-vs-sum-rounding-cfs
rules.sql: WITH legs AS ( SELECT upper(split_part(c.contract_number, '_', 1)) AS client, c.contract_number, c.future_price, c.maturity_date, c.mtm_usd::numeric AS mtm_usd, c.mtm_nc::numeric AS mtm_nc FROM opera.helper_client_statement_report_view_cache_table c WHERE c.tenant_id = :tenant AND c.business_unit = 'CFS' AND c.value_date = CAST(:valueDate AS date) AND lower(c.derivative_type) = 'future' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM opera.client_statement_leg_rounding_table l WHERE l.tenant_id = :tenant AND l.business_unit = 'CFS' AND lower(btrim(l.client_code)) = lower(split_part(c.contract_number, '_', 1))) ), r AS ( SELECT client, contract_number, future_price, maturity_date, count(*) AS legs, round(sum(mtm_usd), 2) AS usd_sum_then_round, sum(round(mtm_usd, 2)) AS usd_leg_then_sum, round(sum(mtm_nc), 2) AS nc_sum_then_round, sum(round(mtm_nc, 2)) AS nc_leg_then_sum FROM legs GROUP BY client, contract_number, future_price, maturity_date ) SELECT client, contract_number, maturity_date, legs, usd_sum_then_round, usd_leg_then_sum, usd_leg_then_sum - usd_sum_then_round AS usd_diff, nc_sum_then_round, nc_leg_then_sum, nc_leg_then_sum - nc_sum_then_round AS nc_diff FROM r WHERE usd_sum_then_round IS DISTINCT FROM usd_leg_then_sum OR nc_sum_then_round IS DISTINCT FROM nc_leg_then_sum ORDER BY abs(usd_leg_then_sum - usd_sum_then_round) DESC NULLS LAST, client, contract_number LIMIT 500

WITH legs AS ( SELECT upper(split_part(c.contract_number, '_', 1)) AS client, c.contract_number, c.future_price, c.maturity_date, c.mtm_usd::numeric AS mtm_usd FROM opera.helper_client_statement_report_view_cache_table c WHERE c.tenant_id = :tenant AND c.business_unit = 'CFS' AND c.value_date = CAST(:valueDate AS date) AND lower(c.derivative_type) = 'future' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM opera.client_statement_leg_rounding_table l WHERE l.tenant_id = :tenant AND l.business_unit = 'CFS' AND lower(btrim(l.client_code)) = lower(split_part(c.contract_number, '_', 1))) ), r AS ( SELECT client, contract_number, future_price, maturity_date, count(*) AS legs, round(sum(mtm_usd), 2) AS s, sum(round(mtm_usd, 2)) AS l FROM legs GROUP BY client, contract_number, future_price, maturity_date ) SELECT client, count(*) AS printed_rows, count(*) FILTER (WHERE s IS DISTINCT FROM l) AS rows_changed, sum(s) AS total_today, sum(l) AS total_workbook, sum(l) - sum(s) AS total_diff, max(abs(l - s)) AS max_row_diff, max(legs) AS max_legs_in_row FROM r GROUP BY client ORDER BY rows_changed DESC, client

SELECT c.value_date, count(*) AS rows FROM opera.helper_client_statement_report_view_cache_table c WHERE c.tenant_id = :tenant AND c.business_unit = 'CFS' AND c.value_date >= DATE '2026-11-01' GROUP BY c.value_date ORDER BY c.value_date
